Estimation engine: weights to tidy output

Source: R/variance.R
dot-run_engine.Rd

Main engine shared by mrn, iptw and crn: takes the per-regime identification weights, enumerates the well-defined potential outcomes, forms the Hajek LW point estimates and contribution columns, assembles the HAC covariance, and returns the tidy output lists.

Usage

.run_engine(
  A,
  C,
  Y,
  W_C,
  W_Y,
  weights1,
  weights0,
  p1_own,
  p0_own,
  unit_weights,
  method,
  design
)

Arguments

A

n_unit x n_unit adjacency matrix (with self-loops).

C

integer vector of cluster ids.

Y

numeric vector of observed outcomes.

W_C

0/1 vector of cluster-level treatments.

W_Y

0/1 vector of individual-level treatments.

weights1, weights0

per-regime identification weights (from one of the weight constructors).

p1_own, p0_own

per-unit own-treatment probabilities under phi_1 and phi_0.

unit_weights

optional per-unit weights (default: uniform).

method

"mrn", "iptw" or "crn".

design

"bernoulli" or "complete".

Value

See mrn.

Examples

set.seed(1)
A <- Matrix::Matrix(outer(1:12, 1:12, function(i, j) abs(i - j) <= 1) * 1,
                    sparse = TRUE)
C <- rep(1:3, each = 4); W_C <- c(1, 0, 1)
W_Y <- rbinom(12, 1, ifelse(W_C[C] == 1, 0.5, 0.2))
Y <- rnorm(12, mean = 2 * as.vector(A %*% W_Y))
w <- generalClusterExp:::.iptw_weights(A, C, W_C,
                                       distC = "binom",
                                       paramsC = list(prob = 0.7))
out <- generalClusterExp:::.run_engine(A, C, Y, W_C, W_Y,
  weights1 = w$weights1, weights0 = w$weights0,
  p1_own = rep(0.5, 12), p0_own = rep(0.2, 12),
  unit_weights = NULL, method = "iptw", design = "bernoulli")
out$causal_effects
#>                       effect            key  estimate     variance           se
#> 1    Overall CE^O(phi1,phi0)     CE_overall -2.103593 1.714485e-01 4.140634e-01
#> 2          Direct CE^D(phi1) CE_direct_phi1  3.354088 6.939894e-02 2.634368e-01
#> 3          Direct CE^D(phi0) CE_direct_phi0        NA           NA           NA
#> 4 Indirect CE^I(1;phi1,phi0) CE_indirect_w1  0.691480 4.683862e-31 6.843874e-16
#> 5 Indirect CE^I(0;phi1,phi0) CE_indirect_w0        NA           NA           NA
#> 6      Total CE^T(phi1,phi0)       CE_total        NA           NA           NA
#>   well_defined
#> 1         TRUE
#> 2         TRUE
#> 3        FALSE
#> 4         TRUE
#> 5        FALSE
#> 6        FALSE
